rows.en: <operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>I was prepared for it, but... I never thought we'd really have to fire on the <color(5)>Macross<ce()>.
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>Is there really no way but to destroy it? If there's anything we could do...
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Hikaru<ce()>! Don't go spouting soft-hearted nonsense!
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>F-Focker?
rows.notes: Source '-senpai' address to Focker rendered as the stammered name; no corpus precedent for this pair.

rows.en: <operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>The <color(5)>Macross<ce()> now would point its guns at you and me both, without hesitation.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>That's not all! It'll hurt civilians too! Is that what you want to happen?!
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>...Sorry, Focker. Hesitating at a time like this...
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>...It's not like I want to do this either. But protecting people's safety is our duty.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Say something spineless like that again and you won't hear the end of it!
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>Yes!!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>But can we really beat something like that?
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Whether we can or not isn't the point! We do it!
<operator(23030,2)><speed(2)>Now that's a good line, coming from you.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>I'd like to get friendly from here on... heh, shame we don't have the time.
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>...Let's go!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Macross<ce()>, as in THE <color(4)>Macross<ce()>? The one that took down <color(5)>Boddole Zer<ce()>... Can we really beat something like that?
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>As an ally it was reassuring, but... seeing it as an enemy is terrifying.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I know. There's no choice but to do it.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>You're starting to sound dependable.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>This kill's mine...!
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>You act without thinking things through way too much. But that's also your strength.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Heh... Not something I want to hear from you.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Damn it! That's my kill.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>This one's mine. Step aside.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Don't you dare die before we settle this!!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>A ship that amazing, seems like a waste to simply wreck it.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Bet it'd fetch a real good price if we put it up for sale...
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>What, what? Thinking back to your old trade at a time like this?
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>Hold on, what are you saying at a time like this? If we leave this alone, it's not only us who...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I-I know! I was only kidding!
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Still as straight-laced as ever.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>What's wrong... <color(4)>Renton<ce()>?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... it's only that this world has so many amazing things in it.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>It's not exactly battle nerves... it's more like one surprise after another. Bad timing to feel that way, maybe.
rows.notes: 'musha-burui' (nervous excitement before a fight) rendered as 'battle nerves'.

rows.en: <operator(23100,2)><speed(2)>Glad you're part of <color(4)>Gekkostate<ce()> now, aren't you?
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>Though it's mostly nothing but chores.
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>Heh...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>You've gotten some backtalk in you, kid. Let's move out.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Right!!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>So the enemy's something out of the ordinary, huh.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Can we even fight something like that?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>It's a crazy situation, but if it's something we have to do, then we simply have to do it.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Sounds like you're growing into your own, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Can't believe there's a transforming robot even bigger than Getter Robo.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>More like a battleship than a robot, though.
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>That much power... It must never fall into the hands of anyone who'd misuse it.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... We can't let this Earth end up like ours.
<operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>Apple or whatever, don't matter - we only gotta smash it, right?
<operator(12061,2)><speed(2)>It's <color(5)>Sharon Apple<ce()>. Honestly, <color(4)>Ryoko<ce()>, you're still hopeless with celebrity trivia.
<operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Shut it! Let's get moving already!
